CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "papers" AS SELECT "pid" AS "pid", "title" AS "title", "conf" AS "conf", "year" AS "year" FROM table_3;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "paper_author_raw" AS SELECT "paper_author" AS "paper_author" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "authorships" AS WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        split_part(paper_author, '|', 1) AS paper_id,
        split_part(paper_author, '|', 2) AS author_id
    FROM paper_author_raw

)
SELECT paper_id, author_id
FROM parsed

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        split_part(paper_author, '|', 1) AS paper_id,
        split_part(paper_author, '|', 2) AS author_id
    FROM table_2
    WHERE paper_author IS NOT NULL AND strpos(paper_author, '|') > 0
),
by_author AS (
    SELECT p.author_id, COUNT(*) AS papers_2009
    FROM parsed p
    JOIN table_3 t ON t.pid = p.paper_id
    WHERE t.year = 2009
    GROUP BY p.author_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT author_id, papers_2009,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY papers_2009 DESC, author_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM by_author
)
SELECT author_id, papers_2009
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
